commercial_demand.assessment: The company is commercial. Reviewed revenue was $459,216 in FY2025 and $347,602 in FY2024, but cost of goods sold exceeded revenue in both years (B2). The traction claims come from an undated testing-the-waters email: 1800 doors, named retail chains, a $100K run rate and Amazon growth. They have no supporting data, so they are unverified (B3). There is no documented loss of customers, collapsing revenue or payer refusal. Revenue grew, so R-DEM-1 is not adverse. Demand quality is unknown: there is no customer concentration data, no contracts, and no gross-margin path beyond the issuer's vertical-integration plan.

competition_and_advantage.assessment: The Form C names Aliea's, Tate's Bake Shop, Dr. Schar and Udi's as competitors and says the market is highly competitive. Its trademarks are registered and the rest of its intellectual property is trade secrets. The pack contains no evidence of a durable advantage, such as margins, retention or independently verified distribution (B9). A substantiated advantage over SCHG is not identified.

financing_and_runway.assessment: Reviewed cash at 2025-12-31 was $116,414, with a separate $1,397,792 of marketable securities. The review report carries a going-concern paragraph (G3). The issuer states $654,000 of cash at 2026-06-30 and about 5 months of runway, which is unaudited. The calculator withheld a current runway (K2) because no spending figure is period-aligned with that cash date (B4). The next milestone, the Wakefern and Wegmans launches, has no stated cost or date (B5). The 2026 email says the higher run rate has accelerated cash burn. Because no funding requirement is stated, the FIN1-A3 shortfall test cannot be run. No default or acceleration is documented. R-FIN-1 is unknown, not adverse. The company depends on this raise ('essential to our operations') and on possible further financing.

regulatory_progress.assessment: The issuer says its products are regulated by the FDA. The pack documents no IRB, FDA authorization or trial milestone, and none applies to a food product. It documents no regulatory action such as a warning letter, hold or consent order, and no litigation. The issuer discloses a possible testing-the-waters disclaimer gap, which is a disclosed risk, not a finding (B8). R-REG-1 is not adverse.

team_execution.assessment: The sole key person is founder-CEO Carolyn Haeler. Her documented background is finance (J.P. Morgan, a hedge fund, IBM consulting). She has led the brand since 2017, and the issuer says the cookies were on sale at Whole Foods by January 2018. The company has 2 employees and the CEO handles a wide range of functions (B10). The pack has no independent verification. It documents no sanction or bad-actor event; only an issuer statement that there is none. Key-person concentration is a documented risk.

technical_and_efficacy.assessment: This is a packaged-food company, so there is no efficacy or clinical question. The pack has no technical validation, product testing or third-party study. The only quality evidence is an issuer press-release claim of industry recognition (B1). It documents no technical failure either, so TECH is unknown, not adverse.

terms_and_investor_proceeds.assessment: The security is a SAFE (Simple Agreement for Future Equity) with a $15,000,000 pre-money cap. The price was set arbitrarily (G7), and K1 withheld an implied equity value. The holder gets no voting rights, no anti-dilution protection and no dividends, and holds only a beneficial interest through a custodian (G4–G8, generic). The cap denominator excludes all SAFEs, including the existing $5,096,791 of SAFEs that the Form C puts at 25.36% fully diluted, so dilution before this holder converts is larger than the headline cap suggests (B7). The Form C also says the issuer cannot determine whether its 3,000,000 authorized shares are enough. The CEO controls 100% of the voting power, acts as the Lead who votes the investors' proxy, and alone directs amendments to the SAFE (B6). Intermediary fees are issuer-paid and no investor-paid fee is stated. Investor proceeds in any scenario are unknown (K3 withheld). The conversion price, the payoff on a liquidity or dissolution event, and who ranks ahead cannot be quantified from the pack. I found no clear R-TERMS-1 term. The CEO's amendment control is the nearest concern but is not shown to transfer value, so TERMS1 is unknown.

issues.explanation: The analysis does not say that the $75,000 target is far below the reviewed FY2025 operating cash outflow of $960,595. The offering can close at the target, so the offering alone may not fund the milestones. The issuer also says it may raise more capital outside the offering. The 'approximately 5 months of runway' statement is dated 2026-06-30, and its timing relative to the 2026-12-18 deadline is not addressed. R-FIN-1 'unknown' is correct, but funding dependence is understated. The software withheld K2, so B4 should not be classed as a 'calculation' when no value was computed.

Stage B missed the Wayflyer inconsistency. Form C gives $51,000 outstanding with maturity 2027-02-28. The reviewed statements show $31,795 at 2025-12-31 and maturity 02/28/2026, which is before the cutoff. The pack has no loan agreement and no statement on repayment or extension. No default or acceleration is documented, so FIN1-B1 stays 'unknown', not established. The gap should be listed as a diligence item.

The press release calls vertical integration 'a core use of proceeds' and mentions hiring executives. The Form C use-of-proceeds table has no such category, and the issuer may alter the use. B5 and Q2/Q4 rely on the email's milestone, but the Form C ties no spending or timing to any milestone. The use of proceeds cannot be tied to a milestone.

The reviewed notes describe customers who 'prepay for services at the time of booking' through a mobile application. They also give a New York headquarters. This does not fit a packaged-cookie business. The mismatch suggests untailored boilerplate. The accountant's review gives only limited assurance and tested no internal controls. Revenue, cost of goods sold and cash figures are therefore reviewed, not audited, and should not be over-trusted. Stage B notes the conflict but gives it no weight.

Stage B correctly leaves R-TERMS-1 and R-FIN-1 unknown rather than adverse. The generic features G3 (going concern), G2, G4, G5, G6, G7 and G8 stay non-decisive. Two risks remain. First, the CEO controlling amendment, waiver and the proxy vote (B6) is not a G8 feature alone, and the pack does not show it transfers value. It should not be turned into an adverse TERMS finding. Second, it should not be dismissed as generic either, because no investor-consent requirement is stated. The correct status is 'unknown, unresolved'.

B8 says no IRB, FDA authorization or trial milestone 'applies to the product'. The pack does not say that. It says only that the products are regulated by the FDA. The statement relies on outside knowledge. The correct position is that no regulatory milestone is described and the pack gives no pathway. The testing-the-waters disclaimer gap cannot be assessed because the Exhibit E image pages are blank. Only one email and one press release are readable.

B9 says the Form C 'states the market is highly competitive'. Its cited quotes (a competitor description fragment and the trade-secret sentence) do not show that. B10 says there is 'no key-person insurance'. Its quote is on p.15, but the insurance statement is on p.16. The claims are probably true, but the citations do not match them as written.

B7 says dilution is 'not capped by the headline valuation'. This follows from the cap's exclusion of SAFEs and notes. Its size cannot be known, since the existing SAFEs' conversion terms are not in the pack. The 25.36% figure is the issuer's own fully diluted percentage and is not independently supported. The text should stay qualitative.

B5 gives as_of 2026-09-28, but the email is undated. B3 correctly calls the traction claims unverified. The email is addressed to prior investors and talks of 'cash burn' accelerating, which also bears on FIN. The press-release claims (e.g. 'award-winning') are marketing and not evidence of demand.

thesis.answer_ko: 발행사 설명에 따르면 소매 확장(Wakefern, Wegmans), 아마존 성장, 수직계열화로 원가를 낮추는 것이 핵심임. 검토 매출은 $347,602에서 $459,216으로 늘었으나 매출원가가 매출을 초과해 총이익이 음수이므로, 마진이 개선되어야 가치가 만들어질 수 있음. 이를 입증하는 자료는 없고 주장은 검증되지 않음.
발행사 이메일은 2026년 4분기 Wakefern·Wegmans 출시와 아마존 성장 지속을 다음 마일스톤으로 제시하나(날짜 불명 이메일), Form C는 금액·시기를 제시하지 않고 사업계획은 '기관 통합'이라는 다른 표현을 씀. 마일스톤 자체의 존재는 발행사 진술로 지지되지만 비용과 일정은 불명.
경쟁 우위를 뒷받침하는 독립 증거는 없음. 상표 등록과 영업비밀만 있고 수상 주장은 발행사 보도자료일 뿐임. 소매 진입 주장도 검증되지 않음.
발행사는 오퍼링 수익이 운영에 필수적이고 외부 추가 자본을 조달할 수 있다고 밝힘. 목표 $75,000은 FY2025 영업현금유출 $960,595보다 매우 작고, 2026-06-30 현금 $654,000에 약 5개월 런웨이(발행사 주장, K2 보류)라고 함. 필요한 총 금액은 마일스톤 비용 미공시로 알 수 없으나 추가 조달 의존이 큼.

SAFE는 현재 지분이 아니며, 최소 $1,000,000 총 조달의 지분 금융(전환)이나 지배권 변경·IPO 등 유동성 사건, 또는 해산시 현금 지급이 있어야 가치를 받음. 이런 사건은 발생하지 않을 수 있고 일정이 없음. 해산시 채무에 후순위이며 다른 SAFE와 동순위로 지급 가능 현금 한도 내임. 기존 SAFE와의 순위는 불명확하고 K3 수익 시나리오는 보류됨.

$15,000,000 사전 가치 상한(분모가 모든 SAFE·전환사채 제외), 임의 가격, 기존 SAFE $5,096,791(발행사 계산 25.36%), 중개사 1.5% 증권, 무의결권·무희석방지·무배당, CEO Lead의 수정·위임 의결, 신탁 보유 구조, 인가 주식 충분성 불명, 최대조달 상향 가능성이 수익에 영향을 줌. 수수료는 발행사 부담이고 투자자 수수료는 명시되지 않음. 희석 규모와 수령액은 계산 불가.
SCHG 대신 이 투자를 택할 근거로 입증된 것은 확인되지 않음. 이것이 SCHG보다 열등하다는 증명은 아님. 유동성 제한, 음의 총마진, 증거가 약한 확장 주장, 불명확한 SAFE 조건, 무의결권이 확인된 사실이며 우위의 독립 증거는 없음.

checks.note_ko: 검토보고서(p.42)는 감사 의견을 표명하지 않는다고 밝힌다. p.20은 감사받지 않았고 내부통제 테스트가 없다고 적는다. 보고서 날짜 2026-07-23도 맞다.
checks.omitted_qualifications: The review report also has a going-concern paragraph. The 'internal controls not tested' wording comes from the issuer risk factor, not the accountant.

checks.note_ko: SAFE 8(c)는 조항의 개정·포기·변경이 CEO('Lead')의 지시로만 가능하고 Lead는 신의성실 원칙에 따라 행동한다고 명시한다. 투자자 동의 요건 언급이 없다는 부분도 정확하다.
checks.omitted_qualifications: The passage covers amendment, waiver and modification at the CEO's direction. It does not say whether investor consent is needed; the claim already says so.

checks.conflicts: Form C p.13 says no stated return or liquidation preference, which sits uneasily with the intended non-participating preferred treatment.
checks.note_ko: p.12와 SAFE 1(d)는 채권자보다 후순위, 다른 SAFE·우선주와 동순위, 보통주보다 선순위이며 비참가형 우선주처럼 작동하도록 의도되었다고 말한다. 전환금액(Conversion Amount)의 다른 순위와 p.13의 상충 문구는 빠져 있다.
checks.omitted_qualifications: The Conversion Amount ranks differently: on par with common stock, junior to the cash-out and liquidation claims. Form C p.13 also says there is no stated liquidation preference.

checks.note_ko: p.130의 보도자료는 수상 내역을 회사 자신의 소개문으로만 서술한다. 제3자 문서가 아니고 기술·효능 근거도 아니라는 주장은 맞다. 다만 이를 DEMAND 근거로 분류한 점은 약한 해석이다.
checks.omitted_qualifications: Only the 'About' boilerplate of the press release is cited. The cited text does not say who selected the recognition or give a source.

checks.conflicts: The p.14 'lack of revenues from sales' wording is boilerplate and conflicts with the reported revenue.
checks.note_ko: p.3에 매출 459,216/347,602, 매출원가 488,693/464,671이 있고 원가가 매출을 넘는다. 각주는 검토된 재무제표임을 밝힌다.
checks.omitted_qualifications: The cited figures are Form C summary figures. Accountant-review status comes from the footnote on that page.

checks.note_ko: p.3의 수치로 두 해 모두 매출원가가 매출보다 크고 매출은 증가했다. 이는 단순 대소 비교로, 검토 수준 재무제표 기준이라는 단서가 붙어 있다.
checks.omitted_qualifications: Gross margin is an analyst computation; the page does not report it. Whether the cost of goods sold line matches the statements is not tested.

checks.note_ko: p.28은 제품이 FDA 규제를 받는다는 일반 문구와 소송 없음만 말한다. '해당 없음' 부분은 문서 근거가 아니라 추론이다. 규제 조치가 기재되지 않았다는 점은 맞다.
checks.omitted_qualifications: The passage says only that products are FDA-regulated in general terms. The claim's 'none applies to the product type' and 'no FDA authorization process' go beyond it. An absence of description is not a statement that none applies.

checks.note_ko: p.30은 J.P. Morgan, 헤지펀드, IBM 컨설팅, Yale MBA, 2017년 창업을 기술한다. XML은 직원 2명, p.29는 CEO가 다양한 업무를 처리한다고 쓴다. 모두 회사 자체 진술이다.
checks.omitted_qualifications: The cited quote (p.29) is cut off; the full sentence says the CEO handles a wide range of administrative and operational functions. The 2017 launch and Yale MBA appear on p.30. 'Sole key person' is an inference from the list of key persons.

checks.note_ko: 문서는 발행인이 bad actor 결격이 없다고 자체 진술한다. 개별 핵심 인물에 대한 진술은 아니고, 클레임의 TEAM 차원 설명이 이를 넘어선다.
checks.omitted_qualifications: The statement is about the Issuer only. It does not cover key persons individually. The claim's attribution says p.28 but the page is the Form C p.36 (body p.28). It is an issuer self-certification.

checks.conflicts: The issuer later reports $654,000 cash at 2026-06-30, a different date and assurance level.
checks.omitted_qualifications: These are year-end figures (2025-12-31 and 2024-12-31), older than the June 2026 cash figure.

checks.note_ko: p.53은 현금이 1년치 미만이고 상당한 의심을 normally 제기한다고 쓴다. p.42는 going concern 문단과 결론 비한정을 기재한다. '회계사 의견'이라기보다 회사가 표명한 의심을 보고서가 인용한 형태이다.
checks.omitted_qualifications: Note 11 says the going-concern factors 'normally' raise doubt, and management plans to fund through debt and/or equity. The report says the company 'stated' substantial doubt. The cited Note 11 sentence is garbled ('which less than a year worth').

checks.conflicts: Net loss $896,217 (p.3) versus net operating loss $933,836 (Note 11) are different measures.
checks.note_ko: Note 11이 영업손실 933,836과 영업현금유출 960,595를 명시한다. 순손실과의 차이는 측정 항목의 차이로 보인다.
checks.omitted_qualifications: The 'net operating loss' of $933,836 differs from the net loss of $896,217 on the cover page. Reconciliation is not in the cited passage.

checks.conflicts: Cash of $116,414 at 2025-12-31 versus $654,000 at 2026-06-30 is not reconciled in the pack.
checks.note_ko: 세 인용은 목표액 75,000, 2025년 영업현금유출 960,595, '필수적' 문구를 지지한다. 마일스톤 소요자금이 없어 검증 불가라는 결론은 신중하며 적절하다.

checks.note_ko: p.13은 의결권이 없다고 하고, 전환 증권에 의결권이 있을 경우 Lead가 대리인이 되어 CEO 지시에 따라 투표한다고 쓴다.
checks.omitted_qualifications: The wording is conditional: the proxy applies 'to the extent' converted securities carry voting rights. The same sentence defines the 'Lead' as the CEO.

checks.note_ko: p.33 표는 Haeler 1,000,000주 보통주 100%를 보여준다. 발행·환매·특수관계 거래에 대한 영향력은 인용문에 없는 추론이다.

checks.note_ko: p.11은 1,000,000달러 이상 모금 시 자동 전환과 15,000,000달러 캡, 조건 (b)를 정확히 기술한다. p.34는 중개인이 사전 가치를 부여하지 않았고 임의 가격이라고 밝힌다.

checks.note_ko: p.9와 XML의 priceDeterminationMethod가 임의 결정을 확인한다. 가격 1.00달러도 XML에 있다.

checks.note_ko: p.11은 분모에서 주식 보상계획 예비분, 전환사채, 본 SAFE를 포함한 모든 SAFE, 그 전환 증권을 제외한다고 명시한다.
